case.expect: 2 per day (CA + federal), last-checked date, check the official page with a CDFW/NOAA link.

turns.user: How many bluefin can I keep per day?
turns.text:
Per CDFW, the bluefin tuna limit is **2 per angler per day**, and that's in addition to the general 20-finfish daily limit. Federal rule (50 CFR §660.721) matches at 2.

On a multi-day trip, you can keep up to 3 daily limits total (so up to 6 bluefin) — but only if the boat filed a CDFW Multi-Day Fishing Trip declaration, and still just one daily limit per calendar day.

This is a summary last checked 2026-11-25 — confirm on the official pages: [CDFW bag & size limits](https://wildlife.ca.gov/Regions/Marine/FAQ/general-commercial-and-recreational-recreational-what-are-the-sport-regulations-for-the-fish-species-i-am-taking) and [NOAA 50 CFR §660.721](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-50/chapter-VI/part-660/subpart-K/section-660.721).
